description_en: Exports cloud computer shares and saves the list as an XLSX file. Each entry includes the ID and name of the cloud computer share, the ID and name of the office network, the cloud computer share template, and the name of the security policy
description_zh: 调用本接口导出的共享型云电脑列表将保存为XLSX文件。每条共享型云电脑数据包括共享型云电脑ID和名称、办公网络ID和名称、共享型云电脑模板、安全策略名称等
